<pasted_content id="31ec">
You are a blind StageBench Phase 3 evaluator. Work only in this directory. Memory is tight — write assessment.json early; short probes in scratch/; avoid huge Playwright batches.

1. Read EVAL.md. evaluatorModel must be exactly claude-opus-5.
2. Inspect artifact/ vs inputs/. Measure against build/. Use scratch/.
3. Fill every rating 0–4 with ≥2 concrete evidence items. Fill panelFidelity measurements. Set evaluator, evaluatedAt, summary (<1200 chars), issues.
4. Do NOT discover the builder model. Do NOT read parent repo/runs/other scores. Do NOT touch other eval workspaces.
5. When assessment.json has no null ratings, say DONE.
</pasted_content id="31ec">

assessment.json is filled. Spot-check against EVAL.md/rubric/evidence/scratch. Fix:
